title: Mango mousse mirror glaze steps
content: Mango mousse mirror glaze recipe: 200 g mango puree, 50 g granulated sugar, 10 g gelatin sheets, 30 ml water. Key steps: 1. Heat mango puree to 40°C; 2. Soak gelatin sheets in cold water until soft, then add to mango puree and stir until melted; 3. Keep the glaze temperature at 30-35°C. Fruit cutting tip: slice the mango thinly, use a mold to press out shapes, and pay attention to layering when decorating.

title: Organizing the mango mousse recipe.
content: Ingredient list: 300g mango puree, 200g whipping cream, 40g fine sugar, 15g gelatin sheets, 80g digestive biscuits, 40g butter. Key steps: 1. Crush the digestive biscuits, mix in the melted butter, press into the bottom of the mold, and refrigerate. 2. Soak the gelatin sheets in ice water until soft, then melt over a water bath. 3. Heat the mango puree with sugar, and stir in the gelatin mixture. 4. Whip the whipping cream to soft peaks, mix with the mango mixture, pour into the mold, and refrigerate for 4 hours. Notes: The mango puree should be strained to remove fibers, and do not whip the cream until too stiff.

3. Wall stretch: stand with your back against the wall, raise both arms up and press them against the wall with palms facing up, feel the stretch in the front of your shoulders, hold for 30 seconds, and keep your spine straight.

title: TCM physiotherapy consolidation record
content:
The three shoulder and neck stretches taught by the physical therapist:
1. Neck lateral flexion: Sit up straight, place your left hand on the right side of your head, gently pull to the left, hold for 15 seconds, then switch sides. Breathing: exhale while stretching, inhale while returning to the starting position.
2. Shoulder circles: Circle both shoulders forward, up, back, and down, 10 times each. Breathing: inhale when moving up, exhale when moving down.
3. Wall stretch: Stand with your back against the wall, raise both hands overhead and press them against the wall, slowly squat while keeping your back against the wall, stretching the shoulders and neck. Hold for 20 seconds, breathing naturally.
After taking the pulse, the Chinese medicine practitioner advised: qi and blood are still weak but recovering well; maintain a regular routine and avoid staying up late.
